html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

A new story is about to begin, meet the team
of Teen Super Heroes whose strong sense of justice rivals
even that of the original Avengers!

 

In this Update Details, we are introducing the December Update,
featuring the Young Avengers theme.

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added for Hawkeye (Kate Bishop) and America Chavez, 
who lead their team with a strong sense of responsibility and conviction. 
They, along with the God of Mischief, Loki, also receive brand New Uniforms!

 

Furthermore, the Kree Super Soldier, Marvel Boy, 
who is prepared with the power of Tier-3 Advancement, 
officially joins MARVEL Future Fight!

 

We have also added a new theme to the Emblem Collection 
that allows Agents to grow their heroes through collecting various Emblems,
and further improvements have been made to the progression conditions for Alliance Battle.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 

 

▣ One New Hero

 

Check out the abilities of Marvel Boy <Young Avengers>,
 a Super Soldier created through Kree experimentation.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

 

▣ Three New Uniforms

 

To celebrate the Young Avengers themed update, three new Uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Loki <Young Avengers>, Hawkeye (Kate Bishop) <Young Avengers>,
and America Chavez <Young Avengers>.
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The three new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <December Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

[12/10 (Wed) 7:54 (UTC+0), 12/9 (Tue) 0:54 (PST) added]

Some text within the Uniform Effect was incorrectly stated and has been corrected.

Applies to: Self  → Applies to: All Allies

 

 

 

▣ Hawkeye (Kate Bishop) & America Chavez Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added for Hawkeye (Kate Bishop), 
who fights with a commitment to justice based on her excellent archery skills, 
and America Chavez, a bold action-taker and interdimensional traveler.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 


▣ Marvel Boy Tier-3

 

Tier-3 Ultimate Skill has been added for Marvel Boy, 
who has begun to understand Earth's culture, diversity, and heroes, 
and fights to protect the planet.

 

 

 

 

▣ Black Cat and Hellcat Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Check out the Potential Awakening & Transcendence abilities 
added for Black Cat and Hellcat in the December Update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 


▣ Additional Alliance Battle Improvements

 

Following the Alliance Battle update on 11/4 (Tue), which introduced a new mode and various improvements, we have prepared additional enhancements to provide our Agents with even greater satisfaction. 

 

1. Schedule and Requirement Changes
We have monitored and reviewed the Agents' feedback 
regarding the Alliance Battle progression changes announced on 11/11 (Tue). 
Please be aware that the schedule and requirements will be changed as follows in this update.

 

▶ Existing Schedule:
- Normal / Extreme / Legend Mode: Monday - Friday (Resets every 15:00 (UTC+0), 7:00 (PST))
- Infinite Challenge Mode: Saturday - Sunday (Resets every 15:00 (UTC+0), 7:00 (PST))

 

▶ Changed Schedule:
- Normal / Extreme / Legend Mode: Monday - Saturday (Resets every 15:00 (UTC+0), 7:00 (PST))
* For Saturday, no separate entry requirements will be set.
- Infinite Challenge Mode: Sunday (Resets every 15:00 (UTC+0), 7:00 (PST))
* No separate entry requirements will be set for Infinite Challenge Mode. 
* Entry requirements other than those listed above will remain the same.

 

2. Infinite Challenge Mode Reward Adjustment
Along with the change to the Infinite Challenge Mode participation day to once per week, we have adjusted the list of obtainable rewards.
Details are as follows.

 

 

3. Infinite Challenge Mode Combat Progression Improvements

- Dodge Timing Guide: When the Enraged Boss initiates a powerful attack, we have added visual effects to clearly indicate the accurate dodge timing.

 

- Boss Status Change: After the Boss’s Rage Gauge reaches 100%, we have improved the visibility so that Agents can clearly distinguish between when the Boss becomes stronger and when it is temporarily weakened, using UI visual effects.

 

- Information Visibility Improvement: The score obtained upon defeating the Boss has been made more noticeable. Additionally, during Bonus time, the remaining Bonus time will be accurately displayed.

 

4. Alliance Battle Mode Selection Convenience Improvement
The preparation screen has been improved to allow Agents to select and change modes by selecting the Requirement information for each mode.

 

 


▣ [The Incredible Hulks] New Emblem Collection Theme

 

A new Emblem Theme, 'Incredible Hulk,' has been added to the Emblem Collection content, 
where Agents can strengthen heroes by collecting Emblems of fascinating MARVEL characters.

 

This new emblem theme will be applied to the 'Alliance Battle' content and offers various options to help our Agents achieve higher scores.

 

 

With the addition of this theme, one collection reward slot has been added.

 

[Information on Reward Appearance Chance by Level for Collection Reward Slot]

 

 


▣ New Artifacts

After the December update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Marvel Boy and Hellcat will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 
Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
one as a 2025 Event Token Archive reward, and two more from the upcoming Event!

 

[December Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Young Avengers.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 


▣ Update Hot Deal Products

 

1.  Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 12/10 Maintenance - 1/6 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 12/10 Maintenance - 1/6 (Tue) 6:59 (PST)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 

2. Emblem related Hot Deal products have been added as follows.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 12/10 Maintenance - 1/6 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 12/10 Maintenance - 1/6 (Tue) 6:59 (PST)
* Please note that the ‘Dimension Chest: Emblem (Heroic - Mythic)’ included in the New Emblem Acquisition Pack will allow you to obtain only the newly added emblems from this update.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Preview Skill: The name has been changed to Skill Training Room, and its accessibility and functionality have been improved.
- This content can be accessed via Menu → Skill Training Room, and the existing entry method via the Hero Info menu remains available.
- The enemy, which previously consisted of multiple entities, has been changed to a single entity with a health gauge, and Knockback Immunity and Immunity to Debuffs ON/OFF features have been added.

 

- You can test useful skill combinations by referring to the health gauge.

 

2. The 'Multiverse Invasion' content has been terminated. 
As a result, related functions have been removed, 
and related challenges and acquisition rewards have been changed.

 

[Daily Challenges]
- [Multiverse Invasion] Participate 1 time → [Team Battle Arena] Participate 1 time
- [Multiverse Invasion] Get 150,000+ points 1 time →  [Otherworld Battle] Participate 1 time 

 

[Alliance Challenges]
- [Multiverse Invasion] Participate N times → [Team Battle Arena] Participate N times

 

[Other Challenge Changes]
Target Quests: S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy, Guide Mission, Returning Agent Quest, Card Crafting Quest, Guided Quest
- [Multiverse Invasion] Participate N times → [Team Battle Arena] Participate N times
* Upon completion of the update, Gold rewards will be distributed.
- Reward: 500,000 Gold

 


3. Store: Accessibility to various content Shops has been improved by adding the 'Token Shop' category.
- The names of some Shops have been revised to be more relevant to their corresponding content.
Token Shop → Timeline Shop
Battlefield Shop → Otherworld Shop

 

 

4. Guide: Information regarding 'Factions' has been added to the Team category.

 

 

5. Alliance: The participation requirements for the Challenge (Weekly Alliance Challenge) have been eased.
- Before: [Timeline Battle] Participate 1,500 times (Weekly), 150 times (Daily)
- After: [Timeline Battle] Participate 750 times (Weekly), 75 times (Daily)

 

6. Settings: Ranked Battle has been added to the content where the 'Display Custom Gear Activated Effect VFX' function is applied.

 

7. Ranked Battle Event: The following improvements have been made.
- The success condition for Counterattack Skills has been eased.
Before: Counterattack Skill success was processed when the designated Counterattack Skill successfully hits the boss during the Counterattack Skill timing.
After: Counterattack Skill success will be processed when the designated Counterattack Skill is used against the boss during the Counterattack Skill timing.
- The types of subordinate villains that appear have been improved.

 

8. Trivia: 25 new quizzes have been added.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. In the 12/10 Update, an issue where point rewards are not being distributed, even after playing the 
Infinite Challenge, when a challenge related to Alliance Battle: Normal is set as a mission in certain events, has been fixed. Accordingly, as a temporary measure, the event mission acquisition points that were increased in the 11/4 Update have been reverted to their original values.
- Events subject to reversion: Future Pass, Cosmic Core, Timeline Survival


2. Content Status Board: An issue where the Epic Quest (Immortals of Olympus) mission was not displayed has been fixed.


3. Store: An issue where returning to the Shop after navigating from a category to specific content using the Back button did not return the Agent to the previously visited Shop category has been fixed.


4. Story: An issue in Stage 1-3 where using a skill with a specific hero caused the hero to become stuck at the map entrance, preventing progression, has been fixed.


5. ISO-8: An issue where attempting to equip an ISO-8 from the Inventory via the Relay Awakening pop-up for an equipped ISO-8 displayed an error pop-up and prevented equipping has been fixed.

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
